name: Shaking Strength out of Bounds
hint: A shaking-strength comparison outside 0–100 cannot represent a sensor reading, so motion-response logic may never behave as intended.
instruction: Validate shaking strength and its thresholds as values from 0 through 100 before using them.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@codeyB shaking strength :: sensing) > (150)> then
say [Invalid shaking]
end
